newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo chairman to appeal jail sentence.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo chairman to appeal jail sentence.

text.p: Kim Woo-choong, the founder and chairman of South Korea's powerful Daewoo Group, will appeal a two year jail sentence imposed by a Seoul court on Monday for bribing former president Roh Tae-woo, a group spokesman said.
"It's inevitable the sentence will be appealed. Otherwise, Kim will be put into jail," the spokesman said.
He said the group was worried about the knock-on effect of the sentence on the South Korean economy. Daewoo is one of the country's top-four conglomerates.
"There are worries that the sentence might have negative impact on the business activities of Korean firms," he said.
